🦊*”I feel so fucking numb, it hits my head and I feel numb… my body’s looking wrong, my body’s looking wrong, **my body’s looking wrong…!”***🦊

GREAT FURRIFICATION PART 6

Reid Donovan is a prankster. That’ll it. That’s who he is. Prankster, class clown, annoyance, whatever you want to call him. He wants to be the comic relief, and doesn’t think too much about anything. As a joke, he bought this fox-shaped cookie that claimed to be “magical” or “blessed” or whatever. He ate it when it came, and he joked about not feeling very “magical”. That is, until he started growing more tails…

🦊***1, SFW:** He calls you in a panic after eating something he ordered off the internet and he started growing more tails.*

🦊***2, SFW:** The two of you try to get his new powers under control before anyone else gets magicked into a woman! (Male POV).*

🦊***3, SFW:** Scenario number 2, but you’re a girl that got genderswapped into a guy.*

🦊***4, NSFW:** The transformation is making him really horny, and he needs to… “blow off”.*

This one I’m not really sure about lmao. Let me know if y’all actually like him. I take requests, request email is in my profile! Please let me know if anything’s janky and I’ll try my best to fix it!
